verses.text: Then Joshua called in Reuben’s and Gad’s tribes and half of Manasseh’s tribe, 🗣️
and told them, ‘You’ve kept every command Moses, Yahweh’s servant, gave you, and listened to everything I told you too. ✅
‘You haven’t abandoned your fellow Israelites all this time. You’ve carried out Yahweh your God’s command. 🤝
‘Now Yahweh your God has given your fellow Israelites rest, just as he promised. So head back to your tents, to the land Moses, Yahweh’s servant, gave you east of the Jordan. 🏕️

‘Just be sure to follow the command and law Moses, Yahweh’s servant, gave you: love Yahweh your God, walk in his ways, keep his commands, stay close to him, and serve him with all your heart and soul.’ ❤️
Then Joshua blessed them and sent them on their way. They headed back to their tents. 🙏
Moses had given one half of Manasseh’s tribe land in Bashan. Joshua had given the other half land with their fellow Israelites west of the Jordan. As Joshua sent them home, he blessed them, 🙏
and told them, ‘Go back to your tents with plenty of wealth—lots of livestock, silver, gold, bronze, iron, and clothing. Share the enemy’s plunder with your fellow Israelites.’ 🎁

So Reuben’s people, Gad’s people, and half of Manasseh’s tribe left Israel at Shiloh in Canaan and headed back to Gilead, their land east of the Jordan, the land Moses had assigned by Yahweh’s command. 🏕️
When they reached the Jordan region in Canaan, Reuben’s and Gad’s tribes and half of Manasseh’s tribe built a huge altar there by the Jordan—impossible to miss. 🏗️
Israel heard: ‘Look, Reuben, Gad, and half of Manasseh have built an altar at the edge of Canaan, in the Jordan region on Israel’s side.’ 👂
When Israel heard, the whole assembly gathered at Shiloh, ready to go to war against them. ⚔️
Israel sent Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest to Reuben, Gad, and half of Manasseh in Gilead. 🗣️
Ten leaders went with him, one from each Israelite tribe. Each was a family head, a leader among Israel’s thousands. 👥
They went to Reuben, Gad, and half of Manasseh in Gilead and spoke to them: 🗣️
‘The whole assembly of Yahweh asks: “What is this betrayal against Israel’s God? Why turn away from following Yahweh and build an altar in rebellion against him? ⚠️
“Was what happened at Peor not enough for us? We still haven’t cleansed ourselves from that sin, even after the plague that hit Yahweh’s assembly. 😔
“Why turn away from following Yahweh now? If you rebel against Yahweh today, tomorrow he’ll be angry with all Israel. ⚠️

“If you think your land is unclean, come across to Yahweh’s land where his tent stands and take a share among us. Just don’t rebel against Yahweh—or us—by building another altar besides Yahweh our God’s altar. 🛕
“Remember Achan son of Zerah? He broke faith over the devoted things, and anger fell on all Israel. He wasn’t the only one who paid for his sin.”’ ⚖️
Then Reuben, Gad, and half of Manasseh answered the heads of Israel’s thousands: 🗣️
‘The Mighty One, God, Yahweh! The Mighty One, God, Yahweh! He knows, and Israel will know too. If this was rebellion or betrayal against Yahweh—don’t spare us today. 🙏
‘If we built an altar to turn away from following Yahweh, or to offer burnt offerings, grain offerings, or sacrifices of well-being on it, let Yahweh himself hold us to account. ⚖️
‘We did this out of concern. We thought, “One day your children might ask our children, ‘What do you have to do with Yahweh, Israel’s God? 🤔
“‘“Yahweh made the Jordan the border between us—you Reubenites and Gadites—and you don’t have a share in Yahweh.”’ Then your children might make ours stop fearing Yahweh. 😟
‘So we said, “Let’s build an altar—but not for burnt offerings or sacrifices. 🏗️

‘“It will stand as a witness between us and you and between our generations after us: we do serve Yahweh with our burnt offerings, sacrifices, and offerings of well-being. Then your children won’t be able to tell ours later, ‘You have no share in Yahweh.’’ 🤝

‘That’s why we said, “If they ever say this to us or our descendants, we’ll answer: ‘Look, this is a copy of Yahweh’s altar our ancestors built—not for burnt offerings or sacrifices, but as a witness between us.’”’ 🛕
‘We would never rebel against Yahweh or turn away from following him by building an altar for burnt offerings, grain offerings, or sacrifices besides Yahweh our God’s altar in front of his tent!’ 🙏
When Phinehas the priest and the assembly’s leaders—the heads of Israel’s thousands—heard what Reuben, Gad, and Manasseh said, they were satisfied. ✅
Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest told Reuben, Gad, and Manasseh, ‘Today we know Yahweh is among us, because you haven’t betrayed him this way. You’ve kept Israel from facing Yahweh’s judgment.’ 🛡️
Then Phinehas son of Eleazar and the leaders left Reuben, Gad, and Gilead and returned to Israel in Canaan with their report. 🏕️
Israel was good with their answer. They praised God and dropped the plan to go to war and destroy the land where Reuben and Gad lived. 🙌
Reuben and Gad named the altar ‘A Witness Between Us: Yahweh Is God.’ 🪧
